en.t: Around May, I thought that Kashiwagi had given me a shakuhachi,

units.source_text: 我该回赠些什么答谢卿我没有钱，

en.t: and that I ought to give him something in return as thanks, but I had no money,

units.source_text: 我把这件事大胆地告诉了柏木。

en.t: so I boldly told Kashiwagi about it.

units.source_text: 柏木当即回答说："我不要花钱买的礼物。"

en.t: Kashiwagi answered at once, "I do not want a gift bought with money."
